nodes.label: Full-bleed app icon: glowing yellow bee-planet on a red-orange gradient
nodes.rationale: 1024×1024 RGBA PNG. Full-bleed square: the painted field reaches every edge, with no transparent corner cutout. A diagonal split runs from the left edge toward the top-right corner, deep red in the upper left (about #951F15) shifting to bright orange toward the lower right (about #FF4E17), with a soft glow behind the mark. The right side of the canvas is slightly translucent (alpha down to about 156). Centered is a pale-yellow glyph, the bee-planet mark: two short detached curved antennae, a dome, a tilted elliptical ring, and a four-lobed body with a narrow vertical gap through the upper and lower lobes. No letters or wordmark.
